content: When fortune turns its face away, even the softest silk can slice your fingers like a razor.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Cho bakht-e to bargardad — Ferdowsi's Shahnameh
explanation: When cosmic fortune is on your side, even reckless gambles seem to succeed. But when the wheel turns, the most familiar comforts become hazards. Never take good fortune for granted, and never mock the person who has fallen under the wheel.
practicalInsight: Walk with quiet, reverent humility today. Do not boast of your advantages, which were granted by grace.
reflectionPrompt: Are you attributing your good fortune entirely to your own cleverness, forgetting how quickly circumstances can shift?
